job.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders)

tailoring.headline: Platform & E-Commerce Cloud Engineer | Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines & High-Availability Systems
tailoring.summary: Backend and platform-focused developer with 5+ years of experience building, extending and supporting high-availability enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Hands-on with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments, with proven expertise resolving integration bottlenecks, tuning database performance, and supporting production issues. Experienced in agile environments, conducting code reviews, and providing technical guidance to junior developers while collaborating across international technical teams to ensure reliable, scalable platform operations.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders)
cover_en.hook: SCAYLE's mission to power high-growth enterprise commerce requires robust, highly available platform engineering under heavy demand. With over 5 years of professional experience building, deploying, and supporting enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in containerized environments, performance tuning, and technical mentorship.

bullets.label: Containerization & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD deployment cycles across agile cloud release workflows, ensuring resilient, repeatable platform operations.

bullets.label: Production Stability & Troubleshooting
bullets.text: Experienced in investigating and resolving integration bottlenecks, leading database query refactoring to reduce latency, and supporting high-priority production issues.

bullets.label: High-Throughput API Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered RESTful web services, headless APIs, and automated data pipelines connecting core commerce engines with enterprise systems under demanding transactional loads.

bullets.label: Technical Mentorship & Enablement
bullets.text: Performed regular code reviews, enforced platform best practices, and provided technical guidance to junior developers within cross-functional, international delivery teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving my notice period with Rockwell Automation through 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my platform and backend engineering experience can support SCAYLE's cloud infrastructure.

tailoring.why_company: SCAYLE stands out as an innovative force shaping enterprise D2C commerce through technical excellence and international collaboration. I am drawn to your culture of treating complex platform problems as opportunities for superior engineering. Contributing to a high-scale, modern commerce platform where platform reliability and developer enablement directly drive client success aligns closely with my commitment to building resilient enterprise architectures.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated to bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in containerized enterprise commerce, CI/CD delivery, production troubleshooting, and technical mentoring to SCAYLE's high-throughput cloud platform.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I noticed the Senior Platform Engineer role at SCAYLE. With 5+ years supporting enterprise commerce platforms using Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and performance tuning at Rockwell and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss contributing to your platform.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders) position at SCAYLE / ABOUT YOU.

With over 5 years of enterprise platform and backend experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD workflows, and production troubleshooting for high-availability commerce environments.

I look forward to discussing how my background can support your platform infrastructure.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
